articles.title: Sunday Summary: Let the Sunshine In!
articles.narrative: This article is a weekly summary covering various commercial real estate news items. It highlights Corcoran Sunshine Marketing Group's continued success in the luxury condo market, noting the firm's relentless pursuit of client satisfaction. The summary also touches on a $99 million construction loan for a large multifamily development on the Upper East Side, a $105.5 million acquisition of a 366-unit multifamily community in Florida, and the refinancing of student housing near Texas A&M. Additionally, it reports on Starbucks' plan to close 250 underperforming stores while simultaneously opening new ones as part of a company-wide revamp. The article also cites a report indicating a significant increase in U.S. real estate investment in the first half of the year, and announces the winners of REBNY's retail deal of the year awards.
